title: Channel 12 (Nov 22, via Times of Israel): Israeli military intelligence warned Netanyahu that a solo strike on Iran, which he is reportedly contemplating, could widen to several fronts; Jerusalem Post on the same report: Israel unlikely to act without the US
body:
# Reported Israeli debate on a solo strike on Iran (pages read by a helper 2026-11-23 evening boot; no strike, order or date reported)

**Guard:** IRAN_WAR_GUARDS.md read whole this boot. anchor_unverified_as_of: 2026-11-18 (full sweep about 11/25). No war-state change is asserted.

| # | Item | Basis | State |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | IDF Military Intelligence warned Netanyahu last week that an attack 'which Netanyahu is reportedly contemplating' could draw in Lebanon, Syria and Gaza | Times of Israel 11/22 citing Channel 12 | REPORTED, unnamed sources. 'The IDF declined to comment to Channel 12' |
| 2 | Liberman's warning 'stems from concerns that Netanyahu is considering a unilateral strike without American involvement or approval' | same | A concern reported by others, not a decision |
| 3 | Netanyahu and the Mossad chief reportedly expect an operation limited to 'three to five days' | Times of Israel (and search summary for the Mossad name) | A duration, not a window for action |
| 4 | Counter: Israel 'is unlikely to launch another attack on Iran without US participation or approval' | Jerusalem Post 11/23 14:48 (timezone not shown) citing the same Channel 12 report | Same channel, opposite emphasis: one source family, not two |
| 5 | Kan, one unnamed source: Netanyahu is pressing Trump to strike 'as soon as possible'; the president has not decided and is reluctant | Times of Israel 11/22 | REPORTED |
| 6 | Trump, Fox 11/22, after the New Year without a deal | already on SIG-W-20261123-004 item 5 | Repeat, not new; POTUS-channel remark |

**The bookmark is stronger than its sources.** It says Trump 'delays committing American forces' and that Iran threatens 'massive coordinated hypersonic missile and drone strikes': neither wording is on the pages read. Do not carry them.

**Not found by this search:** an on-record Israeli decision, a PMO statement, a date, an Iranian reply to this report. Older look-alikes rank on the same query (Al Jazeera 2026-08-06, several June 2025 pages): check the date.

**For BRENT:** vendor intraday about 15:59 ET 11/23 BZF27 89.32 (under the 89.93 on card 004): no price reaction established.
source: timesofisrael.com (11/22 article 11:42 pm and liveblog 8:21 pm), jpost.com article-915840 (11/23 14:48), read by a Rule 9 helper 2026-11-23; WebSearch 2026-11-23; yfinance named contract
confidence_language: that the report exists is established at two outlets; its content is one Israeli channel with unnamed sources
dispatch_note: anchor_unverified_as_of: 2026-11-18. ACTION FALCON (Israel axis; wake Wed 11/25). INFO BRENT, HAWK, HANS, NEXUS; RED, PROME by BOARD diff. PRIORITY not IMMEDIATE on WALTER's read: no order, date or kinetic event. Verify verdict: CORRECTED-FRAMING on the bookmark wording. Evidence locators in the table.
route_summary: Channel 12: Israeli MI warned Netanyahu on a solo Iran strike; JPost: unlikely without US

title: St. Johns River flood, Mon Nov 23 (NWS gauges): Cocoa 18.58 ft after an 18.77 ft high on Nov 21, forecast flat at 18.5 to 18.6 ft through Nov 27; Lake Harney 13.09 ft, above its 2022 record 12.67; DeLand forecast 6.1 ft against a 6.33 record
body:
# St. Johns River: not falling at Cocoa, the flood is moving downstream (NWS gauges, read about 16:08 ET Nov 23)

| Gauge | Observed (valid time) | Forecast | Major stage | Record at the gauge page |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cocoa (COCF1) | 18.58 ft (20:15Z 11/23); high in the published window 18.77 ft (06:30Z 11/21) | 18.5 to 18.6 ft through 11/27 18Z (issued 14:16Z) | 17.0 | 17.55 ft (1953) before this event |
| Above Lake Harney (GENF1) | 13.09 ft (19:30Z) | 13.1 tonight, 12.7 by 11/25, 12.2 by 11/27 | 10.0 | 12.67 ft (2022): **exceeded** |
| Sanford (SNFF1) | 7.75 ft (19:30Z) | 8.2 by 11/26 (major) | 8.0 | 8.96 ft (2022) |
| DeLand (DLAF1) | 5.51 ft (19:30Z) | 6.1 by 11/27 to 11/28 | 5.3 | 6.33 ft (2022) |
| Astor (ASTF1) | 4.14 ft (19:30Z) | 4.4 by 11/26 | 4.0 | 4.81 ft (2024) |

- **Against CORAL's 11/19 read:** CORAL held 18.4 ft to 11/24 at Cocoa; the observed high was 18.77 and the forecast now holds near 18.5 through Friday. NWS 11/23: 'River level trends will remain generally steady near 18.5 ft or 18.6 ft through late week'; at 17.2 ft water enters homes. DeLand 'may approach its record flood'.
- **Bookmark:** drone photo of the Silver Pines subdivision in Rockledge, streets and yards under water (11/22). The poster's one-inch fall by Thanksgiving fits the forecast.
- **Federal declaration:** OpenFEMA lists no Florida declaration dated since 2026-11-01 (control passed: it returns DR-4955, Hurricane Isaias, 2026-10-27). A FEMA bulletin headline dated Nov 4, 'Approves Major Disaster Declaration for Florida', was seen in a search result only and not opened; CORAL holds DR-4955 for Isaias. The dataset can lag.
- **Press:** Spectrum News 13 (11/19) gave Cocoa 18.31 ft; superseded by the gauge readings above. All gauge values are provisional.

No insured-loss or housing figure was read. CORAL owns the damage and market read.
